title: The Wall-Climber

clues.text: The hero wears a round green mask with two very big goggles.
Under the goggles there is a wide, happy smile.
The suit is green, with a bright yellow stripe across the chest.
Each hand has four fingers, and every fingertip is a big round sticky dot.
A short yellow cape flutters behind the hero.
A long curly tail swings from the back, with a little star at the tip.

checklist: Round green mask with big goggles
Long curly tail with a star
